segments.text: This is PolyglotFormFill. You will find it at polyglot form fill dot mooo dot com.

Do you fill the same forms, over and over, with the same details? Forms in a language you do not read? Or help your family and coworkers fill out theirs? If any of this sounds like you, PolyglotFormFill was built for exactly this.

How much of your life is spent filling in forms? A passport renewal. A school enrolment. A job application. A medical form. Every one of them asks for the same name, the same address, the same date of birth, over and over again. PolyglotFormFill fills them all, from one profile you save just once.

Building that profile takes seconds. Snap a photo of an ID, and on-device text recognition reads it straight into your encrypted vault. Name, date of birth, licence number, address, all captured in one shot.
Now the forms. Even the worst kind, a flat scan with no boxes to type in, becomes a live, fillable form right on your device. No printing, no scanner.
Then, one click. Every field is filled from your vault. Name, address, date of birth, all in the right place, instantly.
And not only text boxes. Drop-downs, radio buttons and tick-boxes are answered too. The sex, the marital status, the nationality, all chosen from your saved details.
Your photo and your saved signature drop exactly where they belong. The photo into its box, the signature onto its line. No cutting, no gluing.
Anything the form asks that is new, you type once. PolyglotFormFill saves it to your vault, so the very next form already knows it.
And it is not only your details. Keep a separate profile for each person. One for you, one for your spouse, one for each child, so any family form fills without typing it all again.
At the office, start fresh, with a profile for each recurring form. Inventory, finance, vendor paperwork, each holding exactly the right data. Pick the form, and it fills correctly, every time.
When the form is ready, sign it. Draw your signature by hand, in any ink colour, or drop in the one you saved earlier. Either way it is backed by your device's own key.
It is not only P D Fs. Add the browser extension, and any online form fills in a single click too, from the very same vault.
Faced with a form in a language you do not read? It is translated for you on the spot, and the whole app speaks your language too. Twenty-six of them.
And all of this, the reading, the filling, the signing, happens on your device. We never see your forms or your data.
Stop filling forms by hand. Get PolyglotFormFill, free during the beta, at polyglot form fill dot mooo dot com.
